firm_data.firm_description: Beveridge & Diamond is a top-ranked environmental and litigation firm. They offer strategic advice, regulatory compliance counseling, transaction and project development support, and representation in litigation and alternative dispute resolution.
notable_facts: Named 2026 Environmental Law Firm of the Year by Best Law Firms®
Ranks as a top-tier environmental regulatory and litigation firm by Chambers and The Legal 500
Achieved Mansfield Rule Plus Certification six years in a row

ai_contact.ai_notes: In the coming term, Marc Goldstein will continue to focus on implementing the Firm’s Strategic Plan, including evaluating the quickly evolving marketplace for legal talent, the implications for artificial intelligence in legal practice, and creating a sustainable model for law firm leadership.
